topic: What happens if you take your helmet off in space?

cast.name: Stickman
cast.look: round white head, thin black stick body, astronaut suit with helmet

first_problems: end: who has 'crowd', which is not in the cast
too many wide shots (3 of 7): the characters get tiny

scenes.narration: What happens if you remove your helmet in space?
